description: This source file defines the abstract base class `BaseRoutingStrategy` for various routing strategies in a system, providing common functionality such as batching Redis increment operations, maintaining in-memory cache, and syncing with Redis. It includes methods for setting up background sync tasks, handling Redis and in-memory cache interactions, and managing incremental updates, mainly facilitating efficient and consistent cache and Redis operations in a multi-instance environment.

classes.name: BaseRoutingStrategy
classes.description: Abstract base class for routing strategies, providing core functionality related to cache management, Redis integration, and background sync tasks. Designed to be subclassed for specific routing algorithms.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Cleans up the background sync task during shutdown.

methods.description: Increments a single cache key's value within the current window, updating in-memory cache and queue for Redis increment.

methods.name: periodic_sync_in_memory_spend_with_redis( self, default_sync_interval: Optional[Union[int, float]] )
methods.description: Continuously runs to periodically sync in-memory cache state with Redis at defined intervals.

methods.name: _push_in_memory_increments_to_redis(self)
methods.description: Pushes batched in-memory increments to Redis, merging duplicates for efficiency.

methods.name: add_to_in_memory_keys_to_update(self, key: str)
methods.description: Adds a key to the set of keys that need to be synchronized with Redis.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_key_pattern_to_sync(self)
methods.description: Returns a pattern for keys to be synchronized; default implementation returns None.

methods.name: Set[str] get_in_memory_keys_to_update(self)
methods.description: Returns the current set of keys marked for update.

methods.name: Set[str] get_and_reset_in_memory_keys_to_update(self)
methods.description: Atomically retrieves and resets the set of keys to be updated.

methods.name: reset_in_memory_keys_to_update(self)
methods.description: Resets the set of in-memory keys to update.

methods.name: _sync_in_memory_spend_with_redis(self)
methods.description: Ensures in-memory cache and Redis are synchronized by pushing increments and updating cache values.
